title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text: ‘calls on the Commission to monitor the risks to maritime trade, the supply of food, energy and agricultural input, as well as their prices, to prepare contingency measures, including strategics stocks of foods and materials to support import-dependent partner countries, and to support secure and resilient alternative export routes for Ukrainian agricultural products, while protecting consumers from price shocks;’
